definitions.explanation: A person who accompanies one through life, typically a spouse or romantic partner. A somewhat formal or literary word that carries warmth and implies a deep, lasting bond.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伴侶|はんりょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけたい→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to find a life partner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最良|さいりょう}→最良：18491_sairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伴侶|はんりょ}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think she is the best partner I could have.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伴侶|はんりょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{亡|な}くし→亡くす：30483_nakusu⟧、⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{暮|く}れて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Having lost a longtime partner, he was sunk in deep grief.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, somewhat literary word most commonly seen in the phrase ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伴侶|はんりょ} (life partner). More elevated than ⟦{配偶者|はいぐうしゃ}→配偶者：07430_haiguusha⟧ (which is bureaucratic) or ⟦パートナー→パートナー：11287_paatonaa⟧ (which is casual). Used in speeches, wedding contexts, and reflective writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伴侶|はんりょ} (life partner)
- ⟦{良|よ}き→良い：02350_yoi⟧{伴侶|はんりょ} (good companion/partner)
- {伴侶|はんりょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧ (gain a partner)
- ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伴侶|はんりょ} (traveling companion — literary)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{配偶者|はいぐうしゃ}→配偶者：07430_haiguusha⟧: spouse — legal/bureaucratic term
- ⟦パートナー→パートナー：11287_paatonaa⟧: partner — casual, modern term
- ⟦{連|つ}れ{合|あ}い→連れ合い：06810_tsureai⟧: spouse — warm, colloquial term for husband/wife
